rationale: Tallvine's releases establish Donjon as the 2025 cornerstone and Lind as the 2026 second acquisition under one North American marine infrastructure platform. Donjon and Lind remain separately branded operators, and no distinct legal umbrella was found. Advisor evidence confirms the Donjon close; seller counsel names Tallvine and Thoroughbred as buyers, while Tallvine consistently describes Thoroughbred as the platform's industrial partner. The canonical list should therefore retain the Donjon key as a manager-level proxy, but the broader display name and any separate Thoroughbred owner row should receive proposal-level review because the legal structure and economics are not public.
